entities.name: Reidane
entities.description: Youthful, arrogant god of Justice from Kaldheim who demands equivalent sacrifice for every injustice.

entities.name: Valkmira
entities.description: Legendary shield Reidane carries to protect the worthy.

entities.name: Code of the Clans of Bretagard
entities.description: Code echoing Reidane's belief that injustice is paid with equivalent sacrifice.

entities.name: Beskir
entities.description: Clan Reidane has special regard for, whose founding leader saved Alrund's life.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God whose life was saved by the Beskir founder.

relations.note: She has a special regard for the clan.
